theme: Dark Futuristic Tech (Navy Obsidian & Electric Cyan)

typography.heading_font: Outfit, Clash Display, or System Sans Bold (font-sans font-bold)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-cyan-400

anti_default_rules: Do NOT use Inter for main hero titles — use high-weight display typography or bold geometric tracking
All eyebrow labels must be uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono
Limit hero headlines to maximum text-6xl (never text-8xl or text-9xl)

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0F1D]/80 border-b border-slate-800/80 sticky top-0 z-50
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_card: relative border border-slate-800 hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl bg-[#131C31]/90 shadow-xl overflow-hidden group
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Subtle neon cyan radial ambient halos behind hero text and feature cards
visual_enhancers.tech_grid_background: CSS linear-gradient grid mask (1px grid lines in slate-800/40) overlaying dark navy bg

key_functionalities.kinetic_hero: Line-by-line staggered text reveal using Framer Motion
key_functionalities.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scrolling integrated at root
key_functionalities.editorial_marquee: Infinite moving tech stack strip (AI, Cloud, Cyber, DevOps, React, Python, AWS, Kubernetes)
key_functionalities.services_grid: 8 distinct IT services cards with interactive modal or tab detail view
key_functionalities.projects_portfolio: Interactive project cards with filter tabs and tech stack tags
key_functionalities.why_choose_us_bento: Asymmetric Bento Grid highlighting skilled experts, high SLA, innovative tech stack, client satisfaction
key_functionalities.contact_form: Fully validated contact form (Name, Email, Phone, Service, Message) submitting to backend API /api/contact
key_functionalities.svg_logo_mark: Custom inline SVG logo mark with neon glowing gradient node effect

image_urls.description: Abstract futuristic 3D digital neural network sphere with glowing connected nodes
Digital cloud infrastructure grid with glowing matrix signals
Cybersecurity data hallway with cyan and blue neon lights

Engineer working in front of multi-monitor setup with high performance code

page_specific_guidelines.homepage: Kinetic Hero with glowing particle/network background, headline line reveal, metrics counter banner (99.99% Uptime, 150+ Enterprise Projects, 24/7 Ops), Editorial Marquee strip, 8 Services teaser grid, Bento Why Choose Us, Selected Case Studies, Contact CTA.
page_specific_guidelines.about_us: Overview of TechNova Solutions, Mission & Vision statements, Core Values (Innovation, Security, Scalability, Customer Centricity), Leadership & Engineering Team profiles.
page_specific_guidelines.services: Interactive catalog of all 8 core services: 1. Web Development, 2. Mobile App Development, 3. Software Development, 4. Artificial Intelligence, 5. Cloud Computing, 6. Cybersecurity, 7. Digital Marketing, 8. UI/UX Design. Includes features, deliverable checklists, process workflow.
page_specific_guidelines.our_projects: Portfolio showcase of fictional high-scale case studies (e.g. 'Apex AI Analytics Platform', 'QuantumCloud Enterprise Portal', 'Sentinel CyberGuard Vault', 'FinPulse Mobile Platform') with tech stack tags, problem/solution breakdown, and interactive preview modal.
page_specific_guidelines.why_choose_us: Detailed Bento Grid layout highlighting 4 core pillars: Skilled Tech Veterans, Cutting-Edge Tech Stack, Agile Execution & 99.9% Uptime, Client-First Strategic Partnership.
page_specific_guidelines.contact_us: Interactive dark-mode contact form with live validation (Name, Email, Phone, Service Selector, Message), backend storage integration, interactive office map info, and direct contact details.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.code_format: All files in frontend are JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Use .js file extensions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_ids: MUST add data-testid attribute in kebab-case on every key element (e.g., data-testid='nav-link-homepage', data-testid='contact-form-submit-button', data-testid='service-card-ai').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.navigation_bar: Header MUST be visible and sticky top-0 with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0F1D]/80 border-b border-slate-800). Never completely transparent. Visible nav links on desktop.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing (p-8, p-12, py-20, py-28) to let elements breathe. Avoid cramped cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: Ensure white/cyan text on dark navy cards passes WCAG AA contrast standards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interactive_states: Hover transitions with border color changes, subtle translate-y scale, and cyan glowing shadow on CTAs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.forms: Include validation indicators, loading spinners on submission, and clear success toasts via Sonner.
